I correctly told them that I didn't care about religion being shoved down my throat, and my brother slammed his remote on the table and said, "You're a dumbass. It was held at a fucking church. I just said, "I'm going to go upstairs and try not to cry knowing that my own brother hates me." He accused me of guilt tripping him, but I really did cry. I came back downstairs, and asked my brother to apologize because what he said was hurtful, and he tried minimizing how awful I feel because apparently I'm a scumbag. AITA? His friends said that he took it too far, and he accused all of us of lacking empathy.
